text: In Julian Barbour's timeless interpretation of quantum cosmology, 'Platonia' is:
choices: the space of all possible instantaneous three-dimensional configurations of the universe, each point being a complete 'Now', over which the timeless wavefunction assigns amplitudes
a privileged foliation of spacetime that restores a frame-independent objective present
the discrete partially ordered set of events from whose sequential growth smooth spacetime emerges
the extremely low-entropy boundary condition of the early universe responsible for the thermodynamic arrow
explanation: Platonia is Barbour's arena of all possible Nows (instantaneous 3D configurations); the wavefunction assigns amplitudes to Nows but imposes no temporal ordering. Distractor 1 is neo-Lorentzian presentism's privileged frame; distractor 2 is the causal set of Sorkin and colleagues; distractor 3 is the Past Hypothesis behind the thermodynamic arrow — each a distinct position elsewhere in the unit.
